title: handoff
universal_lens: The sovereign primitives define a strict topological boundary for valid state emissions. By enforcing temporal decay limits, provenance constraints, and structural type invariants, the system constructs a fail-closed manifold where any deviation from rigorous data hygiene results in an immediate projection to the ABSTAIN null-state.
gsi_mapping: Within GSI, these primitives act as hard Bayesian priors on data validity. Stale timestamps or unprovenanced floats represent infinite variance; the conformal inference engine rejects such inputs prior to probabilistic calibration, ensuring that all emitted predictive distributions are strictly conditioned on rigorously verified, temporally coherent empirical evidence.

The situational reasoning layer treats roster anomalies or missing diagnostics as terminal blocking conditions. This guarantees that the execution graph never transitions into a live betting state unless all upstream physical and informational constraints are perfectly satisfied.

Simultaneously, the Provenance Integrity Filter operates as a categorical veto, utilizing strict string normalization to excise any data originating from non-deterministic or manual sources (e.g., 'llm', 'manual'). If a bare float is injected, the system triggers an immediate AttributeError, functioning as a hard circuit breaker against malformed state transitions. Together, these primitives form a unified defense-in-depth architecture, guaranteeing that only structurally sound, temporally fresh, and rigorously provenanced data can traverse the 5-Gate Mandatory Emission Standard.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: These primitives trace their lineage to early 20th-century formal logic and type theory, specifically Russell’s Theory of Types, which sought to prevent paradoxes by enforcing strict hierarchical categorization of mathematical objects. In modern quantitative finance, this evolved into the rigorous schema validation and circuit-breaker mechanisms seen in high-frequency trading systems, where a single malformed packet can trigger catastrophic arbitrage. The handoff report adapts these financial-grade safeguards to sports intelligence, recognizing that unprovenanced or stale data acts as an epistemic paradox within a probabilistic engine.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: From a game-theoretic perspective, the adversarial verifier models a malicious actor attempting to poison the GSE decision matrix. The opposing agent seeks to exploit edge cases—such as injecting bare floats, manipulating ISO timestamps, or spoofing source strings—to force the engine into emitting low-confidence or invalid picks. The sovereign primitives anticipate this adversarial mindset, constructing a zero-trust environment where the engine assumes all incoming data is potentially hostile until it successfully passes the multi-layered gate evaluations.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is maintained by ensuring that the failure modes of these primitives are orthogonal. A timestamp might be perfectly fresh (passing the Temporal operator) but originate from a banned source (failing the Provenance filter). Similarly, a properly sourced object might contain a bare float in a nested field (failing the Structural invariant). This independence guarantees that bypassing one gate does not implicitly satisfy another. The cross-layer veto condition is absolute: if any single primitive evaluates to False, the global `publishable()` method collapses to False, preventing any leakage of compromised states into the live execution environment.
